levels.surface: محمد بن عبد، الله بن نمير الهمداني

notes: two taḥwīl branches meet at قالوا حدثنا الأعمش (rule 3), so the Amash, Zayd and Abdullah names are the shared tail
- واللفظ له - is an editor's gloss on the wording, left out
أبي is the father of Muhammad b. Abd Allah, named only by relation (rule 7)
the Companion Abdullah is last; the Prophet is the end
